commit_message: Fix ADR 0124 navigation contracts and validation failures
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0124 production navigation on the current main baseline: versioned tiled polygon runtime assets, stable multi-agent profiles, backend-neutral build input/baker contracts, height/climb/radius-aware connectivity, typed complete/partial/failure queries, off-mesh links, modifiers and area costs, smoothed steering paths, production agent statuses, and a GUI-free shared bake document/service with deterministic fingerprints, staleness, cancellation, statistics, and safe artifact replacement.

This slice structurally fixes the confirmed affected-validation failures, enforces ADR 0115 current-format-only bake documents, uses the canonical ADR 0124 navigation component IDs, and removes runtime ECS identity from generated navigation source fingerprints. Editor/background-bake, adapter workflow, stale/rebake UX, and visualization remain follow-up slices on this same Draft PR.
